title: Mood Music II
identity: Glenn Smith, Mood Music 2 for any two saxophones of the same type, unaccompanied, Hal Leonard 40180 / LKM Music S152001, 12 pages. The publisher labels it Grade IV–V and lists recordings by Eugene Rousseau and Dennis Bamber.

evidence.claim: Hal Leonard publisher page identifies Mood Music 2 as an unaccompanied duo for any two like saxophones, lists Grade IV–V, 12 pages, catalog number 40180/S152001, and names Rousseau/Bamber recordings. This does not establish the work’s notation or a specific saxophone pairing.

review_focus: The catalog says flexible duet; the publisher specifies two saxophones of the same type. Check the chosen transposed parts and coordination/duet balance in the score. The publisher’s Grade IV–V label is not a SaxoBrain recommendation.
collection_flag: Publisher documents an unaccompanied two-like-saxophone duet and names recorded performances; no intended audience is stated.

listening.description: Publisher page names performances/recordings by Eugene Rousseau and Dennis Bamber.
listening.verification: Publisher metadata verified; recordings not auditioned.

score_links.description: Publisher listing with metadata; closer-look viewer returned no score image, so notation is not inspected.

gaps: Hal Leonard closer-look page yielded no notation image; complete score and exact written range remain unknown.
